'''Mugg Fallow''' was the presumed homeworld of [[Mnggal-Mnggal]], deep in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The grey sludge that formed the being's body (or brain) covered almost the entire planet, with only lifeless continents and the remains of fossilized trees visible. Mnggal-Mnggal filled the planet's former oceans, and ran across the continents in gray rivers.

A fleet of derelict ships formed a ring around the planet, their origins ranging across millennia. Mnggal-Mnggal used its mind-controlled [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]] to pilot the ships there as macabre decoration, with [[Gree sailship]]s and a treasure barge once belonging to [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] among the lifeless fleet.

The [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] location was at least known to the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], who stored the information in their [[Expeditionary Library|data library]] on [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]]. Other species native to the Unknown Regions such as the [[Croke]] and [[Lugubraa]] sought to destroy Mnggal-Mnggal, knowing the extreme danger it posed, but it is unknown if they knew the coordinates of Mugg Fallow.
